items.description: No party may assign the Agreement without the other parties' prior written consent, which may not be unreasonably withheld or delayed.
items.span_text: No party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other parties, which will not be unreasonably withheld or delayed.

items.description: Each party must keep another party's Confidential Information confidential and not disclose it except to permitted recipients who need to know and are bound by confidentiality, absent prior written consent.
items.span_text: Each party agrees that it shall not disclose another party’s Confidential Information, except to its employees, Affiliates, agents, professional advisors, and third-party contractors) who need to know such Confidential Information and who have the legal or contractual obligation to keep it confidential, without first obtaining the prior written consent of the other party.

items.description: Before making a Legal Disclosure, the disclosing party must promptly notify the other party in writing where legally permissible and, if requested, reasonably cooperate at the other party's cost to seek confidential treatment.
items.span_text: the disclosing party shall, prior to making such disclosures (1) promptly notify the other party in writing, to the extent legally permissible, and (2) if timely requested by the other party, use reasonable efforts and reasonably cooperate with the other party, at the other party’s sole cost and expense, to obtain confidential treatment of such applicable Legal Disclosure

items.description: The disclosing party must give seven business days' prior written notice before making a Business Disclosure.
items.span_text: the disclosing party shall provide seven (7) business days’ prior written notice that such a disclosure is about to occur
items.trigger: in the case of Business Disclosures

items.description: Google may terminate the Agreement on 10 business days' prior notice to Akela if a breach of a Material Akela Representation is not cured within that period.
items.span_text: In the event that Akela breaches a Material Akela Representation hereunder, Google may terminate this Agreement upon 10 business days prior notice to Akela, if such breach of such Material Akela Representation is not cured within such 10 business day period.
items.trigger: In the event that Akela breaches a Material Akela Representation hereunder
